lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: Then why is everything so small?

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Because that is what scale model means.

lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: I am not signing off on a building nobody can fit inside.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Nobody is supposed to fit inside it.

lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: Then we agree. Serious design flaw.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: It opens up. Look, the roof comes off.

lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: So now the building is also broken.

lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: I have seen heist films. This is clearly the bit where we stand around the tiny casino.

lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: Then why did you make me wear the black turtleneck?
